name.description: The visitor's full name, exactly as they gave it. Null if they never said it.

email.description: The visitor's email address as confirmed in the conversation. Null if no address was confirmed.

company.description: The company, product or project the visitor is working on. Null if they never named one.

project_type.description: What the visitor wants built, in their own words, in one short phrase. For example a voice agent for inbound leads, or an iOS companion app. Null if the project was never described.

timeline.description: When the visitor needs the work delivered, in their own words. For example next month, or before the end of the quarter. Null if timing never came up.

budget_band.description: Which SheryLabs engagement phase this project starts at, as one of exactly these three values: discovery, production_build, or retainer. Use the band the agent stated in the conversation. Null if no band was stated.
